title: Detailed wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Strap top -->
  <rect x="36" y="3" width="28" height="28" rx="7" fill="#5a4a8a" stroke="#8a7ac8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="9" x2="58" y2="9" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="15" x2="58" y2="15" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="21" x2="58" y2="21" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="27" x2="58" y2="27" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Strap bottom -->
  <rect x="36" y="69" width="28" height="28" rx="7" fill="#5a4a8a" stroke="#8a7ac8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="73" x2="58" y2="73" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="79" x2="58" y2="79" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="85" x2="58" y2="85" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="91" x2="58" y2="91" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="97" x2="58" y2="97" stroke="#b0a0e8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Buckle -->
  <rect x="38" y="88" width="24" height="8" rx="3" fill="#d4a830" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="45" y="89" width="10" height="6" rx="2" fill="#f0d060"/>
  <!-- Case body -->
  <rect x="18" y="27" width="64" height="48" rx="14" fill="#c8a020" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Inner bezel -->
  <rect x="23" y="32" width="54" height="38" rx="10" fill="#a08018" stroke="#e0c040" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Dial face -->
  <rect x="27" y="35" width="46" height="32" rx="7" fill="#201840"/>
  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="37" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#60e0ff"/>
  <rect x="48.5" y="60" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#60e0ff"/>
  <rect x="29" y="48.5" width="5" height="3" rx="1" fill="#60e0ff"/>
  <rect x="66" y="48.5" width="5" height="3" rx="1" fill="#60e0ff"/>
  <!-- Minute ticks -->
  <line x1="38" y1="37" x2="38" y2="40" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="59" y1="37" x2="59" y2="40" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="62" x2="38" y2="65" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="59" y1="62" x2="59" y2="65" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="29.5" y1="44" x2="32.5" y2="44" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="29.5" y1="57" x2="32.5" y2="57" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="67.5" y1="44" x2="70.5" y2="44" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="67.5" y1="57" x2="70.5" y2="57" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="51" x2="50" y2="40" stroke="#ff6040" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="51" x2="62" y2="46" stroke="#ffd040" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Second hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="55" x2="41" y2="42" stroke="#ff80c0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Center pin -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="51" r="2.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Crown -->
  <rect x="83" y="44" width="5" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e0c040" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="85" y1="46" x2="85" y2="52" stroke="#a08018" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Pushers -->
  <rect x="81" y="35" width="4" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#d0b030"/>
  <rect x="81" y="59" width="4" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#d0b030"/>
  <!-- Subdial -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="56" r="5" fill="#302860" stroke="#40a0c0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="56" x2="56" y2="53" stroke="#60e0ff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="56" x2="58" y2="57" stroke="#60e0ff" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Strap holes -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="13" r="1.5" fill="#201840"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="1.5" fill="#201840"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#201840"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="77" r="1.5" fill="#201840"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="83" r="1.5" fill="#201840"/>
</svg>
